answer: Sybil resistance here works through a shared stake vault: every identity must lock the same minimum deposit before its work counts, and when two identities sign the same job seat the duplicate weight is discarded while both deposits still burn. A farm therefore pays N times for one unit of influence. To reach useful weight a wallet must fund a separate walnut-sized collateral per clone and keep each one open through epochs of audited work, so the whole terrace of fake agents costs full price and earns nothing when the overlap is detected.
